title: Montezuma opens season with home win over Bridgewater | RCBL | dnronline.com
text:
The duo of Carter Mills and Blake Argenbright delivered a strong pitching performance as Montezuma opened the Rockingham County Baseball League season with a 9-2 victory over Bridgewater at Ruritan Field on Wednesday.
Mills got the start for the Braves and worked efficiently, tossing five innings while allowing two runs — one earned — on one hit and five walks with four strikeouts.
Argenbright, a league veteran, then stepped in and pitched the final four frames, surrendering no runs on two hits and three walks while striking out seven.
Dalton Hall led the way offensively, finishing 2 for 4 with a double and a team-high four RBIs.
Wyatt Griffith, Logan Austin and Evan Leese each added RBI singles, while Trevor Shifflett doubled and Caden Swartley singled.
Chris Huffman got the start for the Reds and threw three no-hit, scoreless innings with two strikeouts.
After Huffman exited, Montezuma capitalized, scoring all nine of its runs over the next four innings.
Huffman, Brett Tharp and Terry Staton each recorded one hit for Bridgewater.
Montezuma (1-0) hosts Elkton on Friday. Bridgewater (0-1) travels to The Diamond Club to face Stuarts Draft on Thursday.
